mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% within the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 460 thousand units and retail sales below 385,000 million dollars indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 460 AND RSAFS < 385000.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225) trigger aggressive monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 450 thousand units within the past month signals weak consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 450.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 90 (index) within the past month indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 0.15% and CPI inflation above 224 indicate active monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.15 AND CPIAUCSL > 224.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%) signal economic distress, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5.
